title: Kamel Laidi
subtitle: Project Manager & Full Stack Developer
p1: I manage digital transformation projects and build the solutions that go with them. At QUALICONSULT Sécurité since 2022, I coordinate IT teams, field staff and subcontractors on CEE and Fire Safety projects. In parallel, I develop the SAP HANA, Daxium and API tools that automate these processes.
p2: On the dev side: React, Redux, Node.js, SQL Server, SAP HANA, TypeScript. On the management side: planning, subcontractor oversight, reporting, COFRAC compliance. Both skill sets reinforce each other.
p3: Trained at O'Clock (798 hours, RNCP Level 4, React specialisation), I have delivered several full stack applications outside of my professional context: e-commerce, mobile, bilingual dictionary, business tools.
